issue_context.title: Display folder path when hovering over tab
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

I often have multiple folders with the same name opened in different tabs, and it's hard to distinguish them.

### Solution/Idea

Show a brief preview of the path directing to the folder behind its name on the tab. Similar to VSCode. (only if two folders with the same name are opened).

### Alternatives

?
